self_rejected_reason: item 5 (A2 · A day at the market) — the stem 'a part of ___' admitted two defensible answers from the same clause (חיים / עיירה). Lesson 17: the stem is at fault, not the distractor. Regenerated, not hand-patched.
gate_run: storyQuestionGate over all 12 items, allowedLemmas = allowedLemmasAtOrBelow(story_level, bank) built exactly as scripts/build-stories-sql.mjs builds it; allowedHebrew = the translation_he values of those same bank entries.
negative_control: 5 deliberately bad items were gated in the same run and 0/5 passed (unknown_words+not_grounded · unknown_hebrew+correct_is_longest · unknown_words · duplicate_answers · bad_correct_index) — evidence the gate discriminates and did not pass everything.
human_eye_axes: ⛔ sensitive subject — NO deterministic gate exists for this axis and none is claimed. All 12 items were read by the agent; the subjects are school, work, a market, a school policy and a product assessment.
each correct answer was checked by hand against the sentence in the story body that carries it
each distractor was checked by hand not to be a defensible second answer to its own question
ingest_note: ⛔ No runner script exists yet (there is no `npm run build:story-questions`). The gate was run through a throwaway harness outside the repo — CONTENT does not touch code. Ingest is a DEV task.
provenance: כל תוכן נכתב לפרויקט; ⛔ לא נועץ ב-R-010 (מאל"ו) ולא ב-R-013 (AnkiWeb) ולא בשום מילון NC. השאלות נגזרו מגוף הסיפורים שכבר בריפו, והתשובות מתוך translation_he של הבנק שלנו.
